units.source_text: 吟罢微微叹息，深可动人。

en.t: When he finished reciting, he gave a soft sigh, deeply moving to hear.

units.source_text: 这一带地方毫无美景，然而薰君苦苦留恋，不忍离去。

en.t: There was no beautiful scenery in this area, yet Lord Kaoru lingered with painful reluctance and could not bear to leave.

units.source_text: 天色渐明，他终于怕人看清，只得退出，说道：“见了面，欲说之事反而多了。

en.t: As the sky gradually brightened, he at last feared that people would see him clearly, so he had no choice but to withdraw, saying, "Once we have met face to face, the things I wish to say only grow more numerous.

units.source_text: 今后稍稍稔熟，当再向她诉怨。

en.t: When we have become a little more familiar in the future, I shall complain to her again.

units.source_text: 不过她们以世间寻常男子待我，其不明事理实出我意料之外，深可恨耳。”

en.t: But that they treat me like any ordinary man of the world, and understand matters so poorly, is truly beyond what I expected and deeply vexing."

units.source_text: 便走进那值宿人准备好的西厢中，坐着沉思闲眺。

en.t: He then went into the western wing prepared by the night attendants, sat there lost in thought, and gazed idly out.

units.source_text: 但闻懂得渔业的随从人说道：“鱼梁上人好多啊！

en.t: Then he heard an attendant who knew about fishing say, "There are so many people on the fish weir!

units.source_text: 可是冰鱼不游过来，他们都扫兴呢。”

en.t: But the icefish are not swimming in, so they are all disappointed."

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“他们在粗劣的小舟中载些木柴，各自为了简陋的生计而奔忙来往，这水上生涯亦可谓虚幻无常。

en.t: Lord Kaoru thought, "They load firewood into crude little boats and hurry back and forth, each for his meager livelihood; this life on the water too may be called fleeting and uncertain.

units.source_text: 但仔细想来，世间没有一人不和这小舟一样虚幻无常。

en.t: Yet when I think carefully, there is no one in the world who is not as fleeting and uncertain as these little boats.

units.source_text: 我并不泛舟，而住在琼楼玉宇之中，此身难道能永远安居此世么？”

en.t: I do not drift in a boat, but live in jeweled halls and splendid chambers; can this body of mine truly dwell forever at ease in this world?"

units.source_text: 便命取笔砚来，写诗一首奉赠女公子。

en.t: He then ordered brush and inkstone to be brought, wrote a poem, and respectfully sent it to the young lady.
